summary.headline: Cascade Services captures $803K in annual savings across HVAC and maintenance categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Cascade Residential Services to renegotiate OEM programs, lock in distributor rebates and optimize maintenance supply chains. The engagement has delivered $426K in finalized annual savings through signed national agreements with Carrier and Rheem, while an additional $377K is in progress across Lennox, Johnstone, HVACR & Plumbing Supplies, and Uniforms. Key wins include an 8 % Rheem national rebate, a 16 % Carrier rebate plus price concessions, and a 43 % cost reduction opportunity by consolidating uniforms under a GPO program.
